run_generate_rpn_on_dataset: run RPN proposal generation inference on a dataset using a single or multi GPU
run_multi_gpu_generate_rpn: run multi-GPU RPN proposal generation by spawning parallel subprocesses to process images across GPUs
run_generate_rpn_on_range: run RPN proposal generation on a range of images in a dataset using a single GPU
run_im_proposals: run RPN proposal generation on a single image and return scaled bounding boxes and scores
run_evaluate_proposal_file: run evaluation of box proposal average recall on a saved RPN proposal file
